title: Core: AS2 String built-in methods (charAt, indexOf, split)
description: Test compilation of String methods: s.charAt(n), s.charCodeAt(n), String.fromCharCode(65), s.indexOf('sub'), s.lastIndexOf('sub'), s.split(','), s.split('', 3), s.substring(1,4), s.substr(1,3), s.toUpperCase(), s.toLowerCase(), s.trim(), s.trimLeft(), s.trimRight(), s.slice(1,4), s.concat(other). Each should compile. Verify ActionCallMethod (0x52).
